{{Top|leg}}
The '''Ragga Hocce''' was a group of [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] active during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. They were present aboard the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|first]] [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star]], contracted by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]] while the space station project was still classified.<ref name="TCSWE">''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref>
